metadata.description:
Cyber week t-shirts have been a tradition for TeamSPS for more than a decade. In recent years we've also extended the tradition to challenge coins and POAP tokens. The design for these memorabilia is always done after cyber week has come to an end so that we can pull in "the story" of each year. 2023 was the year of massive scale!

"Set Max Scale 800" was the call to action and a cartoon theme with multiple frames was the concept. Starting with an overloaded small town filled with orange infrastructure the scaling call is initiated and digital clouds start to "rain" capacity that scales everything up. The final frame shows the Max Scale with everything in a nice cool blue. Towers built with the cloud infrastructure displaying the monikers of some of our key infrastructure. Skyways connect the towers to show the interdependencies between different systems. The parcel count for cyber week is indicated on the tallest building. SPS Tower is in the mix with a "Rocket to 1" on top! 
Design by Meghan McDermott.
metadata.name: Cyber Week 2023
